help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.body:
1. In Places, create rooms, then cabinets, drawers and other sub-places inside them. Each room can use a room icon or a photo as its cover.
2. On a place, tap “Add item” — a name is all you need. Turn on “Keep adding” to enter many in a row.
3. For boxes and bags, turn on “Use as container”; when you move the box, everything inside follows.
4. To find something, search from Home — results show the full path.
5. Took it? Tap “Take out”. Put it back? Tap “Put back”. Before deleting a record by mistake, check whether undo is what you need.
help.install.title: Install to home screen (iPhone)
help.install.body:
Open the app in Safari → tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”. It then launches like an app and works offline.
Android Chrome: menu → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
Note: camera scanning needs an HTTPS address (or localhost on a computer).
help.scan.title: Scanning
help.scan.body:
Single mode: a label opens its item/place; a product barcode shows where it is; a new barcode starts quick registration.
Batch mode: choose Put in / Take out / Move and a target, then scan continuously. Results queue in a list and change stock only when you submit — if any line fails, nothing is written.
A code staying in view counts once; move away and back to count again. If scanning fails, type the 6-character label code.
help.labels.title: Printing labels
help.labels.body:
More → Labels → generate blank QR labels → print → stick on boxes/doors → scan and bind each to an item or place.
Labels print at real size; choose “Actual size / 100%”. Bluetooth label printers usually need “Save as PDF” then import into the maker's app. Print one 40×30 mm sample and test scanning before printing a batch.
The QR holds the app address plus a random code — no item names or addresses.
help.data.title: Where your data lives
help.data.body:
By default everything is stored in this browser (IndexedDB) — nothing is uploaded. Attachment files too.
Clearing site data, iOS reclaiming storage from unused apps, or a new phone can lose it — export a ZIP under Backup & restore regularly; it contains all records and files and restores completely.
help.sync.title: Cloud sync (optional)
help.sync.body:
To share across devices, deploy the worker/ folder to your own Cloudflare account (the free tier is plenty for a household) or run it on a home computer, create the household under Cloud sync, and enter the sync key on other devices.
If two devices change the same record, nothing is silently overwritten: the cloud version is used and this device's version is listed for review.
help.limits.title: Current limitations
help.limits.body:
· Single-owner household: the sync key grants full access; no member roles yet.
· Product names aren't looked up online; type a name for new barcodes.
· Photos keep only the optimised image; receipts and documents keep originals.
· Test camera and printing on your own devices.
